whenToUse: Grouping related content into a surface: a dashboard widget, a settings panel, a form section.
Header / body / footer layout with the density-aware --gap spacing.
avoidWhen: Wrapping every element on a page — avoid card walls; use spacing and hairlines.
Marketing sections — site blocks are card-less by design.
A clickable record summary — use Entity card or Item.
a11y: A card is not a landmark; give it a heading (CardTitle) so it shows up in the outline.
If the whole card is clickable, use one link and keep other controls outside it.
